claim: Limen cannot set redirect: "manual" on HTTP effects
check: HttpEffectRequest type in limen 0.9.1 dist/generated/core.d.ts and limen HEAD 743cdb9 src/generated/core.ts: no redirect field
note: Real protocol gap at 0.9.0, 0.9.1 and HEAD; matters for token-bearing requests. Candidate protocol revision.

check: docs/11-api-reference.md:419 'ViewItem admits only primitives, so nested lists are not representable'; F# guest ViewValue.Items of Map<string,ViewPrimitive>; runtime probe (0.9.0 and 0.9.1) renders a nested data-each when fed untyped JSON
note: Documented design limit. The JS kernel does not enforce it at runtime (probe rendered nested items), so the contract is checked only by typed guests and the optional view-contract tool.

claim: Limen Core does not manage focus (app hand-writes focus move/restore)
check: limen v0.9.0 tag contains src/capabilities/focus/index.ts (focus, selection and scroll capability pack, LCP-007; added 2026-09-29)
note: True for Core, but an optional focus capability shipped in the version R2 used; discoverability problem rather than a missing feature.

claim: Limen does not answer the engine's own navigation with LocationChanged
check: docs/11-api-reference.md:122,366: LocationChanged is sent only when the browser moves on its own (Back/Forward); a Navigation push yields a NavigationResult
note: Accurate description of documented behaviour, not a limitation; the app's workaround (route follows the push) matches the documented model.

claim: Limen exposes no beforeunload (leave guard must be app-side)
check: limen src/capabilities/lifecycle/index.ts:15 and docs/48-page-lifecycle.md:89: the pack deliberately never listens to unload/beforeunload (bfcache eligibility)
note: R10 boundary.js registers beforeunload only while unsaved (PERSIST-019) - a reusable pattern Limen could document as a recipe.

claim: Limen measure does not wait for document.fonts.ready
check: grep fonts.ready in limen HEAD src/: no occurrence; git log -S finds none
note: Code-inspection only; behavioural impact (layout measured before web fonts) not reproduced here.

claim: (docs) A template with more than one root reports BridgeError {phase: binding}
claimedBy: limen docs/11-api-reference.md:116-119 (shipped in the 0.9.1 package docs)
check: Runtime probe in headless Chromium 153 with limen 0.9.0 and 0.9.1: data-if and data-each templates with two element roots mount only the first root, kernel status 'running', no BridgeError; code checks only template.content.firstElementChild
note: Silent drop caused R7 D-05 and causa fda2056. Fix: check content.childElementCount === 1 (or non-whitespace nodes) in templateProblem and at mount; add to check-views.

claim: (observed) No rehearsal used Limen's shipped view-contract tooling
